label: The totality of received actual esse-bearers has an actual cause of its esse
paraphrase: OPEN analyst premise A, attribution deferred: on one fixed q3a4 profile, if some actual bearer has received esse (it is not uncaused in ActualEsseCause), then some actual bearer is a cause of the esse of the totality of all received actual bearers taken together (TotalityCause, an explicit primitive, read in the collective sense TOTALITY_CAUSE_1). The totality need not be closed or finite. Not asserted: that this cause is outside the totality, unique, efficient, present or necessary. A is substantive only jointly with B: some predicate satisfies both exactly when one actual bearer causes every received bearer's esse. Under the collective reading the Hume-Edwards view denies A: a totality whose every member has a cause needs no cause of its own beyond its members' causes (TOTALITY_CAUSE_2).
